dct_creator_sm: University of Toronto Mississauga Meteorological Station (UTMMS) (University of Toronto Mississauga Geography Department).
dct_description_sm: Weather data for the last two months of 1999 are presented here. Parameters include Temperature, Relative Humidity, Wind Speed and Direction, Precipitation and incoming short wave solar radiation. While every effort is made to maintain calibration of our sensors, we cannot guarantee the accuracy of all data.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available without information on how it can be used. You should communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
